mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher equity valuations due to reduced discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (measured at decision time) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.5% (UNRATE) indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 8.5% (measured at decision time) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.5% and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below $350,000 million, it signals a dual stress on labor and housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE>8.5% and RSAFS<350000 (measured at decision time) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 225 (measured at decision time) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 (index 2017=100) signals weak economic activity, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO is below 95 (measured at decision time) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 520 thousand units signals weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where HOUST is below 520 (measured at decision time) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate liquidity effects.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (measured at decision time) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 13400 billion dollars (2017 chained) signals a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where GDPC1 is below 13400 (measured at decision time) over the last 10 years.
